data.long_meaning: Utkarsh is a name derived from Sanskrit. It means 'Progress', 'Advancement', or 'Success'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and carries a strong spiritual significance. The name Utkarsh carries the meaning “Progress, Advancement, Success” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Utkarsh usually hope their child will grow to embody progress, advancement, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
